exact_prompt_lines: Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: original 2D game-character concept sheet, Round009 mythic-force candidate 01 of at most 04

Input images: Image 1 is authoritative ONLY for Nyra's already-solved exact same-hilt contact topology: one complete sword and both complete hands visibly closed on separated cobalt-wrapped regions of its same continuous hilt. Image 2 is authoritative for Nyra Kestrel's exact mature face, asymmetric braid, body, handed yoke/load-path/greave identity. Image 3 is authoritative for the exact Stormcage odachi. Create new art; do not copy Image 1's passive studio stance or civilian technician costume.

Primary request: one clean 1536x1024 landscape concept sheet dominated by exactly ONE complete full-body three-quarter combat-load pose of Nyra Kestrel as an iconic mythic storm-warden lead. No inset unless absolutely necessary. Her singular authored thumbnail silhouette must read as: upper-left split thunder yoke, diagonal torso conductor, lower-right massive grounding greave, and one long odachi forming the counter-diagonal.

Composition/framing: pale warm-gray studio background only, subtle contact shadow. Entire yoke terminals, head, braid, both arms/hands, both legs/soles, one pommel, one blade tip fully inside generous margins. Body's main axis descends from upper-left yoke/shoulder to the dramatically heavy RIGHT grounding foot planted in the lower-right quadrant. The lighter LEFT leg braces toward lower-left. The single long odachi counter-diagonal rises from pommel at lower-left through two hands near center to guard/caged base and blade tip at upper-right. No crop, no environment, no inset text.

Combat force/anatomy: a decisive loaded beat, not a neutral ready pose and not a running leap. Heavy character-RIGHT grounding foot is flat and planted, knee tracking over broad sole; the lighter left leg braces and pushes. Pelvis turns against the planted right leg while ribcage counter-rotates toward the blade. Spine inclines into resistance. Shoulders are offset, lats engaged, elbows and forearms form a credible force chain; both wrists neutral and visibly transmit the mass of the long blade. Center of mass sits over the broad right sole. Directional intent is toward upper-right as if arresting or redirecting enormous blade inertia. Storm-cloth, tassets, straps, plates and conductor hardware visibly respond to torque: inner cloth compresses at the loaded hip, outer tassets trail slightly, shoulder layers bunch, straps pull taut, plates overlap/compress on the loaded side. Weapon mass must feel heavy through anatomy and material response, with no VFX.

Exact identity invariants: preserve the same mature lived-in woman's face—low brows, slightly crooked nose, subtle under-eye fatigue/crow's feet, healed brow notch, unsmiling vigilant expression—and exact short asymmetric braid with ceramic beads. Preserve one attached split warm-IVORY ceramic induction yoke mounted behind and around character-LEFT shoulder only, a thick broken C/open squared horseshoe with two blunt terminals and clear gap, attached to a blackened-steel load frame. Preserve one mechanically protected oxidized-copper conductor crossing diagonally from yoke through torso fastenings into one compact RIGHT-hip capacitor, then continuing into the one dramatically heavier character-RIGHT grounding greave with blackened-steel slabs, copper shunts and extra-wide flat zero-heel sole. LEFT leg remains visibly lighter.

Mythic costume transformation: replace the civilian coverall/tunic impression with a deeply authored layered storm-warden construction. Large interlocked worn warm-ivory ceramic lamella and reliquary-like insulating shapes form an asymmetric shoulder mantle, sternum bridge, rib/hip protection and forearm shells; these are functional electrical insulation, angular and architectural, not generic samurai scales or knight plate. Beneath them, deep-cobalt woven storm-cloth forms wrap layers, articulated sleeves, overlapping torque-responsive tassets and leg wraps, with visible hand-built woven texture and ritual repair seams. A restrained blackened-steel load frame visibly carries the yoke and anchors armor under load. The single oxidized-copper structural conductor is integrated into ceramic fastenings, hinge pins, clamps and tension closures so it reads foundational, never bolt-on decoration. Keep broad capable shoulders, solid waist, powerful thighs, realistic anatomy; no bust sculpting, corset, cleavage, fetish shaping or heels. Materials are matte and worn at contact edges only. Silhouette hierarchy and big shapes before microdetail.

Exact weapon/contact invariants, highest priority: exactly ONE complete Stormcage odachi, identical to Image 3: one gently curved blackened-steel blade; one small pale mineral billet physically caged in a stout black rectangular frame ONLY at blade base; one broad low rectangular ivory ceramic guard; one long oval deep-cobalt woven-insulated hilt with ivory ferrules and central separator; one capped ivory pommel; recessed copper never on gripping surfaces. Both complete hands remain visibly CLOSED around separated regions of that SAME continuous blue-wrapped hilt, character-RIGHT/leading hand below guard and character-LEFT/trailing hand above pommel, with exposed blue grip and ivory separator between hands. The hilt visibly enters and exits both fists; each hand has one thumb and four curled fingers with contact pressure and wrap compression. No hover, gap, malformed digits, fused hand, crossed wrist, body penetration, detached part, duplicate guard/hilt/blade, second sword or scabbard.

Style/medium: premium original 2D industrial-mythic fantasy character concept painting, crisp hand-authored controlled edges, restrained linework, matte material separation, pale studio clarity; no photoreal cosplay, no 3D render.

Hard reject if: passive/neutral weight distribution; civilian technician/workwear read; generic samurai, knight or cyberpunk silhouette; missing/detached yoke; broken/mirrored load path; wrong heavy leg; either hand not enclosing the same continuous hilt; weapon duplication/detachment; malformed anatomy; crop.

Avoid: text, labels, logo, watermark, environment, lightning, glow, particles, action smear, motion blur, dramatic VFX, cape, skirt, long coat tails, horns, wings, antlers, decorative spikes, generic samurai, generic knight, generic cyberpunk technician, glossy plastic, pin-up anatomy, franchise cues.

rejection_reasons: The load shift is stronger and all identity/contact/weapon-count invariants remain readable.
Both hands remain too low near the pelvis, leaving the shoulders and upper back insufficiently loaded by the long blade; the body still reads as a guarded presentation stance.
